response.sql: WITH customer_counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM Orders), scored AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) AS share FROM customer_counts CROSS JOIN total) SELECT customer_id, order_count, share FROM scored ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no orders are eligible for the top 10; their share is zero when orders exist. If there are no orders, shares are NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Include only customers who placed at least one order.
